summary: George Russell won the Canadian Grand Prix Sprint from pole position, 1.3s ahead of Lando Norris, with Kimi Antonelli completing the podium.
Liam Lawson made the biggest climb, from P18 to P11.
Isack Hadjar had a day to forget, dropping from P8 to P21.
The stewards penalised HUL (10 second time penalty) and PER (10 second time penalty).
There were 6 pit stops in total; the winner stopped 0 times.
Kimi Antonelli leads the championship by 18 points over George Russell.
